integrity: The exact-rational finite-horizon program checks specified instances; all infinite and universal assertions rely on the explicit analytical martingale proof. Earlier known qualitative non-minimum-norm behavior is not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-dimensional rank-one consistent inverse model with independent uniform data-row and coordinate samples, zero initialization, positive constant step below the scalar mean-square residual threshold. No extension to general matrices, dependent sampling, time-varying steps, nonaligned noise, or finite precision is established.
title: Exact nullspace-risk frontier for doubly sampled rank-one inverse updates
